detail: Any new research execution, data fetch, validation, dry-run discussion, or bot action requires explicit approval.
Must be proposed before any research resumes; Candidate D cannot be silently revived.
Rules must be frozen before testing; no tuning after seeing results.
Metrics, data scope, pass/caution/fail bands, no-trade comparison, and forbidden work must be documented first.
Any future active candidate must beat no-trade after fees.
BTC-relevant work must compare to passive BTC benchmark.
Candidate D or any future candidate cannot be optimized after failure evidence.
DOGE/DOT/UNI and other weak markets remain visible unless exclusions are predeclared and separately validated.
